statements.quote: cumulative exposure to Bt toxin and to other genetic engineering byproducts — combined with the herbicide residues (glyphosate) that accompany genetically engineered crops designed to tolerate those herbicides — may contribute to increased intestinal permeability in humans.

source.title: Mad Honey, chapter 4: the pharmaceutical machine (Nir Strulovitz)

statements.note: A hypothesis; I have not proven it (Nir).
